spans.s: smi, seemingly = asmi, I am: Gv 〔231.5〕 (vs), see 〔§§ 4.7〕; 〔28.64〕.

smitī-mukha, adj. Bhvr. (cf. late Skt. smiti, once, Schmidt, Nachträge; Skt. smitamukha), with smiling face: ep. of Māyā, ˚khā sā LV 〔28.12〕 (vs); Calc. smitā-m˚, but all mss. reported smitī˚ except one smiti˚ (meter requires long).
